description: Drop a Goal that will not be done, with the reason; its Plan File stays as a record. Releases this Session's Claim on it. A Goal another running Session holds, or one already done, cannot be dropped. To drop a single Task, use update_tasks (action drop).

reason.description: Why the Goal will not be done.

stop_repeating.description: For a goal a routine made: also stop the routine, so it won't come back.

name: drop_goal
title: Drop Goal
